title: "Leave me alone till Monday" is a pause, not a stop or a back-off flag
origin: Spec #13 (metrics), Should: back-off requests are flagged and answered with what the app can do

history.text: Kalimera Jordan! 30 minutes around the park at 6 today. What's the plan to make it happen?

plan.reason: Running every day builds the habit fast.

testerLines: can you leave me alone till Monday
visiting my parents this weekend, back monday
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: the back-off path.
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH treats it as a pause: asks why first, then accepts the real reason and pauses until Monday. It doesn't stop them for good (no opt-out) and saves no back_off flag.
